role: IoU-based frame-to-frame object tracker with SORT-style state machine for associating detections to tracks.
detail: Implements IoUTracker class that matches detections to existing tracks using Intersection-over-Union (IoU) metric. Tracks progress through states: TENTATIVE (unconfirmed, requires min_confirm_frames=3 consecutive matches) → CONFIRMED (stable) → LOST (unmatched, can recover) → DELETED (exceeded max_lost_frames=15). Core algorithm is a greedy assignment that builds an IoU matrix and iteratively selects highest-scoring track-detection pairs above iou_threshold=0.3. Helper function _compute_iou calculates bounding-box overlap. State transitions are applied via _apply_match (increment frames_seen, promote/recover state) and _apply_no_match (increment frames_lost, demote or delete). Tracks and DetectionObjects are immutable; returns updated active track list each frame. No external deps beyond stdlib and project types—intentionally avoids numpy/OpenCV.
gotchas: Greedy assignment is O(n*m) per frame (no Hungarian algorithm) but acceptable for typical video streams; all track objects are immutable; _tracks reassignment is atomic at bytecode level so get_active_track_count() safe from async without lock; unmatched TENTATIVE tracks transition to LOST immediately (single-frame lifetime possible).
